args.reason: The DoD goes beyond the PRD's declared goals. The --dry-run flag serves the inspection goal, but the persisted .faff/merge-gate-history/<pr>.jsonl log, the --explain timeline of every past evaluation, and the --since and --format options are historical storage and query features, which the first PRD goal explicitly places outside this PRD. The Phase-1 claim that this is a natural extension of inspection ignores that exclusion. Two of the three DoD items deliver capability no declared goal covers.
